## Requirements (spec contract)

1. Workspace-inherited metadata: `version = "0.1.0"`, `repository`, `homepage`,
   `documentation`, `readme`, `keywords`, `categories`, `rust-version`,
   `description` per crate; path deps carry `version = "0.1.0"`. `rust-version`
   declared deliberately — the pinned 1.94 unless an MSRV check proves a lower
   floor; a CI step builds the workspace at exactly that version
   (`cargo +<rust-version> check --workspace --all-targets`).
2. `publish = false` on fixtures/plugins/test-support (list recorded in an ADR
   with the rule applied per crate); the umbrella `hharness` facade crate
   re-exporting the public API crates + a README install section.
3. `scripts/publish-order.sh` — topological publish order +
   `cargo publish --workspace --dry-run` (or per-crate `cargo package` in order)
   green; name availability re-checked against crates.io at run time over the
   final publish set (record `date -u` + per-name result). A run-time collision
   is a **STOP-and-ask** — never a silent rename or quiet drop.
4. `.github/workflows/release.yml` — on tag `v*` and `workflow_dispatch` (dry
   mode: build + checksum artifacts, no release): the ADR's targets (4 by
   recommendation), `SHA256SUMS`, attaches to the GitHub Release; SHA-pinned
   actions; the dry-mode run executed on this PR's branch, artifact list recorded.
5. CHANGELOG `0.1.0` section filled from the round's landed work.
6. Release ADR (next free number): (a) publish set + rule applied per crate;
   (b) `rust-version` decision; (c) v0.1.0 target set —
   `aarch64-apple-darwin`, `x86_64-apple-darwin` (cross-built on the arm64 runner
   if no Intel runner), `x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu`, `aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu`
   (native on `ubuntu-24.04-arm`; if unavailable at dry-run: STOP and ask);
   **Windows excluded** — helper backends are seatbelt (macOS) + podman (Linux)
   only, a Windows build ships without its containment floor (revisit trigger);
   (d) docs.rs readiness — `[package.metadata.docs.rs]` where needed + a scripted
   check documenting each publishable crate under its docs.rs settings
   (`cargo doc -p <crate> --no-deps` with those features) green.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Publish dry-run over the whole ordered set green (output recorded) *(engineered)*
- [ ] `release.yml` dry-mode run produced `hh`/`hh-kernel`/`hh-helper` for every
      target in the ADR's set + `SHA256SUMS` (run URL recorded) *(engineered)*
- [ ] The release ADR records the publish set, `rust-version`, target set
      (incl./excl. reasons) and docs.rs settings; CI builds at the declared
      `rust-version`; the docs.rs-settings doc check green *(engineered)*
- [ ] Every publishable crate has complete metadata (scripted check in CI) *(engineered)*
- [ ] Universal phase-gate AC *(agentic)*

Out of scope: the actual `cargo publish` / tag push / release — HUMAN-H7.

## Plan

1. Root `[workspace.package]` → version `0.1.0` + repository/homepage/
   documentation/readme/keywords/categories; rust-version stays `1.94`
   (only toolchain installed — no offline MSRV check for a lower floor).
2. Scripted manifest sweep (python): inherit the new fields in all crates,
   `publish = false` on the 5-crate fixture/plugin/test-support set,
   `version = "0.1.0"` on every path dep whose target is publishable
   (path-only kept for the publish=false dev-dep `hharness-plugin-fixture`,
   which cargo strips at package time), a `description` for `hh-lab`
   (the one crate missing it), `[package.metadata.docs.rs] all-features`
   on the tier-gated crates + facade.
3. New umbrella crate `crates/hharness` — facade re-exporting the 46
   publishable lib crates; `tier-c1`/`tier-c4` forwarded (C4 crates as
   optional deps → honest removal).
4. `scripts/publish-order.sh` (topo order + crates.io re-check +
   `cargo publish --workspace --dry-run`) with stub seam
   `HH_PUBLISH_STUB_FILE`; self-test `scripts/ci/test-publish-order.sh`.
   `scripts/check-publish-metadata.sh` (CI). `scripts/check-docsrs.sh`.
5. `ci.yml`: MSRV check + publish-metadata + docsrs steps (all gated
   non-fast, ubuntu leg); self-test registered.
6. `release.yml`: tag `v*` + `workflow_dispatch` dry mode; 4 ADR targets;
   per-target tarball + sha256 + combined `SHA256SUMS`; `gh release
   create` on tag only; SHA-pinned actions.
7. README install section, CHANGELOG 0.1.0 filled, ADR-0380 +
   regenerated indexes (adr README, REVISIT_TRIGGERS, BACKLOG BL-47).

## Test matrix

- publish-order stubbed collision → exit 3 STOP (test-publish-order.sh b)
- stubbed inconclusive → exit 3 (test c)
- all-free stub → order printed, topological, publish=false excluded (a)
- publish=false drift vs recorded set → exit 2 (d)
- metadata completeness check → green locally + CI step
- docs.rs settings doc build per publishable crate → green
- `cargo publish --workspace --dry-run` over the 49-set → green (recorded)
- release.yml dry-mode dispatch on this branch → artifacts recorded
- MSRV: `cargo +1.94 check --workspace --all-targets` → green
- full build + test workspace → green
